rules.name: Strict 0.1% Consumer Cap on Hydrogen Peroxide
rules.title: Strict 0.1% Consumer Cap on Hydrogen Peroxide
rules.expected_requirement: Maximum 0.1% w/w hydrogen peroxide present or released in cosmetic products sold directly to consumers.
rules.explanation: Unlike the US (which allows up to 14% OTC), EU Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009 strictly limits consumer oral hygiene and cosmetic products to 0.1% hydrogen peroxide. Concentrations between 0.1% and 6% can only be sold to registered dental practitioners.
rules.fix_suggestion: Reformulate formulation to <= 0.1% hydrogen peroxide, or use approved alternative whitening agents.

rules.name: Total EU Ban on Hydroquinone in Cosmetics
rules.title: Total EU Ban on Hydroquinone in Cosmetics
rules.expected_requirement: Hydroquinone is completely prohibited in cosmetic products placed on the EU market under Annex II.
rules.explanation: Hydroquinone causes ochronosis and is classified as a skin-lightening prescription medicine, strictly banned in cosmetics.
rules.fix_suggestion: Remove hydroquinone completely and replace with compliant actives such as Alpha Arbutin or Niacinamide.

rules.name: Absolute Ban on Lilial / Butylphenyl Methylpropional
rules.title: Absolute Ban on Lilial / Butylphenyl Methylpropional
rules.expected_requirement: Strict zero-tolerance ban on Lilial (BMHCA) across all cosmetic formulations.
rules.explanation: Lilial was reclassified as a Reprotoxic Category 1B substance and added to Annex II prohibited list.
rules.fix_suggestion: Reformulate fragrance profile to substitute Lilial with non-CMR aromatic compounds.

rules.name: Prohibition of Crude and Refined Coal Tar in Cosmetics
rules.title: Prohibition of Crude and Refined Coal Tar in Cosmetics
rules.expected_requirement: Coal tar is a known carcinogen listed under Annex II and prohibited in cosmetics.
rules.explanation: Coal tar distillates are classified as Category 1A/1B carcinogens prohibited from cosmetic placement.
rules.fix_suggestion: Replace coal tar with compliant antidandruff agents like Piroctone Olamine or Zinc Pyrithione (where permitted).

rules.name: Total Ban on Mercury and Corticosteroids in Cosmetics
rules.title: Total Ban on Mercury and Corticosteroids in Cosmetics
rules.expected_requirement: Mercury and corticosteroids are prohibited under Annex II items 221 and 300.
rules.explanation: Cosmetics containing mercury or clobetasol are toxic adulterated goods triggering immediate EU Safety Gate RAPEX recall.
rules.fix_suggestion: Immediately discontinue manufacture and export of formulations containing banned mercury or clobetasol.

rules.name: Ban on High Power Consumer Laser Pointers (>1mW / Class 3B)
rules.title: Ban on High Power Consumer Laser Pointers (>1mW / Class 3B)
rules.expected_requirement: Consumer laser pointers must not exceed Class 2 (<1mW) under European harmonized standard EN 60825-1.
rules.explanation: Class 3B lasers (>5mW to 500mW) cause irreversible retinal damage and are banned for consumer sale in the EU.
rules.fix_suggestion: Cap optical output power strictly below 1mW (Class 2) and provide EN 60825-1 laboratory test report.

rules.name: Cosmetic Claim Substantiation & Medical Borderline Prohibition
rules.title: Cosmetic Claim Substantiation & Medical Borderline Prohibition
rules.expected_requirement: Claims must adhere to common criteria. No therapeutic or curative claims allowed for cosmetics.
rules.explanation: Advertising cosmetic products as arthritis cures or medical remedies breaches Regulation 655/2013.
rules.fix_suggestion: Replace medicinal claims with cosmetic beautification/soothing descriptions supported by a Cosmetic Safety Report (CPSR).

rules.name: Mandatory EU Responsible Person (RP) Contact & Address
rules.title: Mandatory EU Responsible Person (RP) Contact & Address
rules.expected_requirement: Name and address of the EU-established Responsible Person must be printed on primary and secondary packaging.
rules.explanation: Imported cosmetics cannot enter the European single market without an EU entity designated as Responsible Person holding the Product Information File (PIF).
rules.fix_suggestion: Designate an EU-based Responsible Person and print their legal business name and postal address on packaging.

requirements.name: EU Responsible Person Mandate
requirements.description: Signed RP agreement & address on pack.

rules.name: Mandatory INCI Ingredient Nomenclature & PAO Symbol
rules.title: Mandatory INCI Ingredient Nomenclature & PAO Symbol
rules.expected_requirement: Complete ingredient list utilizing International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) names and Period After Opening (PAO) open-jar symbol.
rules.explanation: Cosmetic packaging omitting INCI ingredient listing or PAO shelf-life symbols violates mandatory consumer disclosure rules.
rules.fix_suggestion: Print complete ingredient breakdown in INCI format and display standard open jar symbol with month indication (e.g. 12M).

requirements.name: INCI Ingredients & PAO Marking
requirements.description: INCI list & PAO open jar symbol.

rules.name: EU Safety Standard for Baby Walkers (EN 1273 Compliance Check)
rules.title: EU Safety Standard for Baby Walkers (EN 1273 Compliance Check)
rules.expected_requirement: CE Declaration of Conformity and accredited test report to European Standard EN 1273:2020 (stair fall and tip testing).
rules.explanation: Unlike Canada, the EU permits baby walkers provided they undergo strict laboratory stair-fall prevention testing under EN 1273.
rules.fix_suggestion: Provide laboratory certificate proving compliance with EN 1273:2020 and verify base-width stability.

rules.name: CE Mark, RoHS & WEEE Compliance for Electrical Goods
rules.title: CE Mark, RoHS & WEEE Compliance for Electrical Goods
rules.expected_requirement: CE marking on device, EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC), RoHS substance testing, and WEEE crossed-out wheelie bin symbol.
rules.explanation: Electronic beauty wands and appliances must satisfy electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), RoHS restricted substance caps, and WEEE disposal marking.
rules.fix_suggestion: Affix CE mark, WEEE wheelie bin symbol, and compile technical dossier including RoHS test reports.

requirements.name: CE Declaration of Conformity (DoC)
requirements.description: Signed EU DoC citing EMC, RoHS.

rules.name: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) EU Economic Operator Requirement
rules.title: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) EU Economic Operator Requirement
rules.expected_requirement: Every consumer product placed on the EU market must have an EU-based Responsible Economic Operator whose name and physical/electronic contact details appear on the product or packaging.
rules.explanation: Effective December 2024, GPSR mandates that online and offline non-food consumer goods without an EU Economic Operator cannot be lawfully imported or sold on European marketplaces.
rules.fix_suggestion: Appoint an EU Authorized Representative or importer and print their name, postal address, and email on packaging.

rules.name: Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 for Food Contact Materials
rules.title: Framework Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 for Food Contact Materials
rules.expected_requirement: Food contact kitchenware must not transfer chemical components to food in quantities that endanger human health, and must bear the Glass-and-Fork symbol or 'for food contact'.
rules.explanation: Bamboo cutting boards using toxic urea-formaldehyde adhesives or unapproved plastics violate EU food contact migration standards and trigger RAPEX border recalls.
rules.fix_suggestion: Conduct overall and specific chemical migration testing according to EN 1186 and ensure cutting board bears the Glass-and-Fork symbol.

rules.name: Low Voltage Directive & Hair Care Appliance Safety (EN 60335-2-23)
rules.title: Low Voltage Directive & Hair Care Appliance Safety (EN 60335-2-23)
rules.expected_requirement: Electric grooming appliances operating at 50-1000V AC must hold an accredited safety test report under EN 60335-1 and EN 60335-2-23 verifying thermal cutout protection and CE marking.
rules.explanation: Electric hair dryers combine high heat with electrical power. Without verified EN 60335-2-23 laboratory testing and thermal overheat protection, products present severe fire and shock hazards.
rules.fix_suggestion: Obtain an ISO 17025 accredited laboratory safety test report according to EN 60335-1 and EN 60335-2-23 and affix the CE mark on product rating plate.

requirements.name: EN 60335-2-23 Electrical Hair Care Safety Report

rules.name: REACH Restriction on Phthalates in Plastic Consumer Enclosures (Annex XVII)
rules.title: REACH Restriction on Phthalates in Plastic Consumer Enclosures (Annex XVII)
rules.expected_requirement: Plasticized components and polymer housings must not contain cumulative DEHP, DBP, BBP, or DIBP phthalates exceeding 0.1% by weight.
rules.explanation: REACH Annex XVII Entry 51 strictly restricts toxic phthalate plasticizers in plastic enclosures. Non-compliant plastic housings trigger immediate RAPEX border detention and customs destruction.
rules.fix_suggestion: Submit a REACH SVHC / Phthalates Certificate of Analysis (CoA) proving cumulative phthalates <= 0.1% w/w in plastic casing.
